source_caption:
Jason Statham actually worked as a street vendor before becoming an actor, just like the hustler he plays in the opening of the film. Makes the whole intro of Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels feel even more authentic.

source_details.synopsis: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels is a 1998 British crime comedy film written and directed by Guy Ritchie. It follows a heist involving a confident young card sharp who loses £500,000 to a powerful crime lord in a rigged game of three-card brag, prompting him to pay off his debts by enlisting his friends to help him rob a small-time gang operating out of the apartment next door. It stars an ensemble cast featuring Jason Flemyng, Dexter Fletcher, Nick Moran, Jason Statham (in his film debut), Steven Mackintosh, Vinnie Jones, and Sting.
